item: Lane O: other tabs ready for ordinary people
summary: Falling rates read with a down arrow (trendRateText was hardcoded to up: a super-group at 0.44x showed an up arrow); Commodities/Indices/Agenda grids fit 320 px; Observatory labels wrap on narrow canvases and the sky lays out with one inner radius; 24 px targets on chart legends, Commodities tools, Observatory table, tag chips; Agenda caveat and Indices note stated once; super-group sparkline at drawn size. Journalist 2a/2b/4a/5a were already fixed.
